from cyhole import Cyhole

# Initialize Cyhole client
client = Cyhole()

# Request a swap quote (order): SOL to USDC
quote = client.get_swap_quote(
    input_mint="So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",  # SOL
    output_mint="EPjFWdd5Au17hunznztC2yhAH5Q4wEsxU9MRXoEL3mo",  # USDC
    amount=1_000_000_000,  # 1 SOL in lamports
)

print("Quote:", quote)

# Execute the swap using the quote
